data.body:
**[P2] Preserve the invocation-end flush on worker re-entry**

When an exporter re-enters `on_invocation_end`, that hook may queue a closing record and then call `drain()` on this worker. This branch returns without requesting a flush or extending an existing flush barrier. The worker can therefore export the newly queued terminal record and exit without calling `flush()`, leaving buffering exporters' terminal telemetry vulnerable to Lambda freeze. Before returning, enqueue a non-blocking flush request and extend its barrier through the current sequence; add a regression that observes the flush without a later external drain.
